Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + secure transfer options

Hi Alicia / Nebula security team,

Hope you’re well — I’m following up on the security diligence for the NDL-4892 opportunity. The buyer’s security and procurement teams have asked for the latest SOC 2 Type II report for Redwood Inference (preferably the full report, plus any auditor bridge letter that extends or explains coverage if your testing window doesn’t align with the customer’s required period).

To make this easiest for you, we can accept the materials via one of the following secure channels:
- SFTP (preferred) — we can provide an inbound path and one-time credentials
- Shared GDrive folder with enforced link expiration and view-only access (2FA recommended)
- ShareFile or secure transfer link (TLS + password)

Minimal items that would close this request for our buyer:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF, redacted where necessary)
- Any bridge letter or auditor confirmation if the report’s period doesn’t cover the buyer’s required window
- Control-to-product mapping document (short spreadsheet) or an inventory of scope in CSV
- Auditor name and contact info (for validation calls)

We’ve attached a short evidence inventory template (evidence-inventory-template.csv) that speeds internal review — you can reuse it if helpful. If there are confidentiality constraints, we’re happy to sign an NDA or accept a redacted version first.

Suggested reply (feel free to paste):
"Hi Ben — we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter via SFTP. ETA 1–2 business days. We will also include auditor contact info. Please send SFTP details and any PO/NDA required."

Two quick operational notes:
1) If the report is >250MB, please upload to SFTP or provide a secure folder rather than attaching to email.
2) If there’s any required acceptance/PO to share the full report, please flag it in your reply and we’ll coordinate.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Ben Carter

ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
